tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rin chen ril nag chen mo'i zin bris brtan g.yo'i bcud bsdus mkhas pa dga'

byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// rlabs chen smon lam bcu gnyis las grub pa// mtshan tsam thos pas nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad pa yi// sangs rgyas sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba'i spyan sngar byang chub thugs bskyed nas// sems can skad cig tsam yang mi bsnyel bas| |zhing 'dir g.yu thog yon tan mgon po zhes// 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig gang khyod spyi bos mchod// de nyid slar yang bsnyel med gangs can 'dir| |mtha' bzhi'i gzhung lugs 'thor ba rab gzigs nas// rtsod dus 'gro rnams bu bzhin skyong ba la// dharma swa mi zhes bya'i sku drin las// rags bsdus phra zhib gdams pa dpag med rnams// rgya mtsho lta bu'i nang nas yid bzhin nor// deng sang bod yul ljongs 'dir dbul mthong nas// ma bzod bla ma'i drin las legs byung ba// gdams pa 'di'o bod sman 'ga' 'ga' yis// rin chen sbyor ba'i lag len rgyang bsrings nas// 'phral sel sman sbyor dag la gso dpyad ces// de 'dra'i sman pa'i brtul zhugs rgyang bsrings te// 'du ba'i nad kun sel byed bdud rtsi'i mchog /ma hā ma ṇi sbyor ba 'di spro na// khong yangs blo bzang bskyed la lam 'dir zhugs// 'di la spyi don gtso 'khor sa bcad ni/ 'bigs byed g.ya1 'a phyi kṣa 2 ra rnam pa lnga// dug phral 'ching byed 3 lcags brgyad za byed kyi// khams4 bcas btso zhing 'bigs byed mche ba dang*// klu 5 dbang sprad btso rin chen gzugs sgrub bo// gtso bo gzha6 na lnga dug phral sbrang gshog gtub// bsreg 7 par bya ste gtso bo drug po thal/ lcag8 sa rtsi len dang zla 'od lcag9 sa rtsi bdug /ri10na po che yi sde dang rdo sma11 na sde// bzang 12sman sde dang sngo sma13na sde tshan dang*// 'bru14 sman sde dang shing 15sman sde dag dang*// 16ra sgro 17spu dang 18sha sman 19brun sman sde/

spom20 du 21sbyar te 'tha22ga thabs ril 23bur dril// bsten 24thabs 25dam tshig 26phan yon lo 27rgyus te// spyi don sa bcad nyer bdun khog phub la// rang rang sde tshan la yang mang du yod// de ltar sa bcad 'khrul med sor bzhag nas// da ni de 'grel sman gyi sbyar thabs bstan// dngul chu tshad ldan srang gang sogs mang nyung gang byed kyang kastu ri shun gla lpags nang*// shun gri'i sga skya phye mas yun ring bar du mnye// de bzhin ma rī tse dang pho ba ril pippa lī'i pi pi ling*// phye mas g.ya' dug ma thon bar du mnye// de nas kṣa ra rnam lngas bkru ba ni// nar kṣar ma nu ṣa pa mi'i dri chu dngul chu dang*// phyogs gcig snur tshad da dhi zho bzhin gyur tshe// pā nī chu bskol a wo ṭis bkrus sngar ltar 'gyur// a shwa kṣa ra a shwa pā nīs rta'i dri chu bsnur// tshad dang bkru rdzas gong ltar byas pas 'grub// ga bo kṣa ra gau pā nīs ba'i dri chu bsnur// tshad dang bkru ba gong ltar bya ba gces// sardzi kṣa ra ser tshur chu yis bsnur// tshad dang bkru ba gong ltar bya'o skad// traṃ kṣa ra ste lau na pā nīs lan tshwa'i chu bsnur// tshad dang bkru sogs gong ltar byas pas 'grub// kṣa ra lnga la spyi nor tsu kā star bu phran tshegs dri chu dang sbyar ba ste/ /lnga gar bsre ba gnad kyi man ngag yin// de nas btso phyir 'di nas ba bla ldong ros dang*// dngul rdo gser zil gru bzhi khab len dang*// lhang tsher sbal rgyab brgyad 'di'i bar gyi rdo sman brgyad po 'di 'ching byed kyi khams brgyad yin la rkang mar mi'i tshil dang rkang lug gi rkang 'o ma'i spris ma 'phyi ba'i tshil star bu rnams chu la sbyar ro/ 'di za byed kyi khams lnga yin 'grogs// long rdo kha rub nang du gzhug byas la/

/agni me dag la dal bu'i sbyor ba yis// yun ring btsos pas lhad med nam mkha' 'dra// dngos gzhi 'bigs byed zla ba gzugs can dang*// shi sha zha nye dang ni rā ga waṃ go gsha' dkar gnyis// phyogs gcig bsdebs pa 'bigs byed tshad zha nye dang gsha' dkar bsdebs pas cha gnyis dngul chu dang mnyam zer yang dper na zho bcu re la srang du byas pa'i dngul chu srang gang la gsha' dkar zho brgyad tsam dang zha nye zho bdun tsam dgos pa yin zhing gang ltar rung byas la rngul chu nyar nyer med pa sra khang la phos phos 'ong ba dgos snyoms rnams// 'bru mar yungs kar sogs nang du a wo ṭis bskol sbyor ni// gcig tu bsgrubs pas gang 'dod rin po che// zla ba rgyas sra zhing dkar ba pa lta bu'i gzugs su 'grub// hru'i gser ni dngul chu'i tshad mnyam lcags skyogs su// a ru da tshur lan tshwas btsos byas la// chus bkrus rdzas ro dor te sbrang gshog brdung*// de nas dkar gong dag dang lhan cig 'dru// de nyid dul tshe dkar gong chus g.yengs dor// slar yang dri ma bral phyir de dag kyang*// spyin dang sug chur phyogs gcig bskol la spyin dang sug chu phog /de nas bsreg par bya phyir gnyen po ni// rang las sum 'gyur kandha ka mu zi ser po// nyis 'gyur ṭaṅga na tsha la dang til nag rnams// zar khus brdzis pa lde gu byas bskams nas// kong bur bcug pa sol mer bsreg bya ste// tshig tshad kandha mu zi'i dri med pa kong bu'i phyi'i me lce sngo skya yal ba tshos pa'i tshad yin tshur bton la// grang nas thal sol star bu lan tshwa yi// chus bkrus rin chen ljid ldan slar bkrus pa// gang dgos dngul chu'i tshad ldan longs spyad do// o hu dngul dngul chu nyis 'gyur sbrang gshog ni// dkar gong las sbyor dul tshe chus g.yengs dor// sreg dus gnyen po kandha sum 'gyur dang*// ṭaṅga na ni nyis 'gyur zar khus brdzis// lde gu kong bu sreg tshad bkru ba sogs// hru'i lta bur byas pas 'grub par 'gyur// tamba zangs dngul chu sum 'gyur mer bsregs la// dmar yeng song tshe chang la bcug bsregs pa// sbrang gshog then la lan tshwa star bus 'di chu btso// dkar gong gis bcad chus g.yengs ro ma dor// phye ma dul ma sreg pa'i gnyen po ni// sum 'gyur kandha mu zi ka dang nyis 'gyur gyi// ṭaṅga na tsha la sbyar zar khus brdzis pa yi// ril bu kong bu sreg tshad bkru ba sogs| |hru'i ji bzhin byas pas 'grub par 'gyur// lo ha lcags dngul chu bzhi 'gyur yod pa yi// sag rdar gyis brdar phye mar byas pa ni// sreg pa'i gnyen po rang las sum 'gyur gyi// kandha ka mu zi dang ṭaṅga na tsha la dag dang*// rang las nyis 'gyur a ru gser mdog sbyar// chang gis brdzis la lde gur byas pa de// kong bu sreg tshad bkru ba la sogs kun// hru'i ltar bya de ni legs par 'grub// da ni gsang ba'i sman gcig zab khyad can// a bha ha ri lhang tsher mang nyung dngul chu dang mnyam pa nag po zhes bya ba'i// med thabs med pa'i gdams pa bstan pa ni// tsha ga'i ra thug og zhol sbre dang star bu dang*// dar ba sbyar ba'i nang du zhag gsum sbang*// bangs tshe thang khug nang du mnyes byas la// de nas dkar gong gis bcad chus g.yengs dor// de nyid bsreg pa'i phyir du gnyen po ni// rang las sum 'gyur mu zi de dang nyis 'gyur tsha la dang*// zhan nag dag ni bsres la zar khus g.yos// lde gu kong bu sreg tshad bkru ba sogs// hru'i lta bur byas pas de nyid 'grub// de ltar 1 rū pa pā nī dngul chu 2 hru'i gser dang ni// o 3 hu dngul dang ni 4tamba zangs lo 5 ha lcags dang*// gsang sman a bha 6 ha ri lhang tsher nag po ste// gtso bo dus kyi grangs ldan legs grub bo// da ni 'khor gyi sman rnams 'di lta ste// dbyig dug sel phyir lcags rtsi'i 'khor bstan pa// a ru gser mdog nyer gcig gu sha zhib btags te// lo brgyad byis pa'i chu'am sdom ldan chus// skyo ma gar sla zho tsam byas pa des// lcags snod nang du blugs la mer bskams pa// kha dog mthing nag lta bur gyur pa de// tshur la bsdus pa dum bu gnyis byas pa'i// gcig ni lcags rtsi dkyus ma yin phyir dang*// gcig ni li sder nang du blugs byas la// yar tshes bco lnga'i zla ba shar ma thag

/bstan la mtshan der bzhag nas phyi nangs bsdu// de ni zla 'od ldan pa'i lcags rtsi ste// lcags rtsi rnam gnyis7 mang zhing bzang dbyig dug sel ba'i mchog /de phyir 'khor gyi thog ma lcags rtsi'o// lha dang mi yi rin chen rigs rnams ni| |rdo rje zho bcu 8 pha lam khyung skyu 9 gas dza ra mo ra zho dgu 10man shel zho brgyad dang*// padma ra11'a ga zho bdun ind+ra nī 12la zho bdun na13la zho bdun// ga14yu rnying bzang po zho bdun dang sbu15 ra len zho gsum spu16ga zho gsum dang17 mu tig zho lnga 18dung zho gsum// 19mu men zho gsum byi 20ru zho dgu de ltar rdo rigs dang shel rigs kyi rin po che 'di rnams// brtan g.yo zhu ba mi zhu'i khams las grub pa'i phyir na dug 'phrog mchog tu bstan| |rin chen rnams dang ljid tshad mnyam pa yi// ze tshwa ldum bu re ral be skyes ral// gang chung gsum po ze tshwa gsum cha re gla rtsi dri thon tsam tsha la dang a ru ra gser mdog gnyis sngo gsum dang mnyam| |'gron thal tshwa 'debs tsam star bu che na bzang sbyar byis pa'am// khrims ldan chu nang rin chen de rnams kun// khram khrum brdungs blugs nyin gcig btso bar bya// de rjes chus btso slar yang chang gis btso// de nas chu yis bkru la dug dang phral// nus ldan skyon dang bral ba'i ratna rin po che'i sman 'grub// rdo sman sbal rgyab 21gangs thigs mañdzi 22ra// dkar po chig 24thub 25khab len cong zhi 26dang*| |lcag27sa rdo mdung rtse dam28 ra po mtshal 29dkar rdo sman thams cad srang gang re bya'o sbyar// ze tshwa zho gang 'gron thal zho gang rdo sman 'ju phyir bsre// bzang sman 30cu gu31ra li 32dang 33dzā su34ga 35ka bzang drug srang gsum re'o// gla36nga chen gi waṃ zho gsum rtsi dang dom 37mkhris zho gsum ka38sturi gla rtsi zho gsum// ko byi39la bya 'phul sleb bcu gcig grangs ldan chur brdungs ka 40pu ra ga pur srang gang*// sngo sman bong nga dka41ra se42ra da43mar po dang*// dpa' bo dka44ra se45ra dpa46'a rgod sug smel 47sman dmar ser gang rigs// glang chen chi48ga thub rnam par yu 49gu shing gi khaṇḍa dgos// bud med ma reg char nyung kha50ṇḍa dang*// zur logs mchod rten brtsegs pa'i mchod sdong51 gang ga chung dang*// ming po brgya yi sring gcig g.yu rgyan 52ma brag skya ha bo// be skyes re 53ral tsi tra 54mū la byi'u la phug dang*// ghi55dda dhū paṃ bya rgod spos dang ni a bhi 56ṣa// spang rgyan dka57ra po kyi lce da58kar po rnams// rang rang mang nyung tshad ldan gzhung gi sngo sman thams cad zho bdun re'o sngo sman sde// 'bru sman yungs 59kar pad 60khang nyu61nga son rnams// bud med nyi mas ma reg sgong skogs re// dbyar nyi ma log gong du rab bsgrubs pa'i// gzi mdangs med pa'i rgya62la po srad nag ma'i myu gu khyor ba gang*// shing sman tsandan da63kar da64mar ar 65nag dang*// skye66ra sa67ེ 'om 68bu gsum gyi bar shun shing sman 'di rnams zho bdun re dang*/

lung thang sman rtse ma rul rdog po gsum// sta69ba seng zho bdun rnams ni shing sman sde tshan no// rwa sman spyi bor chi70ga skyes bse ru dkar po zho bdun tshad ldan dang*/ /sgro sman rma bya'i sgro da71gu li sder nang*// sūryas nyi ma bsregs pa'i gzhob hrog tu song ba dang gzugs mo yi/ /byi 72thur sor bzhi'i tshad ni grangs bdun ldan sbyar// spu sman stag gi sma 73ra bubs gcig dang*// bu mo stag lo'i ma gtsang ma'i spyi 74skra mchan 'og 75spu// li sder nang du 'od bsregs gzhob hrog tu song ba de'o// sha sman bu mo stag lo'i lo bcu gsum la glo bur du shi ba mchi76na pa ma rnyed na phag ma gsar gyi mchin pas tshab rung dang*// skyes dar grir shi'i 77nywa lag pa'i sha zho gang dang*// mi yi tshi78la dang sha ba'i tshi79la rnams so// brun sman ma80ི 81rta khya82ི gsum phrug gu ni// btsas ma thag pa'i chu tshan zho re re// mang nyung tshad ldan dngul chu dang mnyam pa mu zi se83ra po ste// de ltar sgos kyi gnyen po rnams rkang grangs su mi the ba'i sman sna gtso 'khor bsdoms pa la// brgyad cu rtsa gsum grangs nges kha skong dang bcas pa ste kha skong gi sngon ma thams cad zho lnga re ma nor ba// gza' skar 'phrod sbyor rab tu bzang po'i dus// dben pa'i gnas su bla gab ldan pa'i nang*| |oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ra sa yā na ta na dza ya gu hya siddhi hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā/ zhes pa'i gzungs sngags bar med bzla bzhin du// sra ba'i rigs nas 'go bzung go rim bzhin// phye mar btags te dul bar gyur pa na// se 'bru'i khu bas bran la gar sla'i tshad// zho tsam byas te zhag bdun nyin mtshan du// rdo gzhong drod ma yal bar bar med 'thag /bai ḍūrya yi mdog mtshungs byang ba'i tshad| |de tshe ril bu sran phos tsam du dril// dar nang rlung gi 'gyu ba'i phyogs su yang*// grib skam byas te cung zad thag yod tshe// ga pur chu yi na bza' bsgron la dril// de rjes zar ma'i chu yis brtan par bya// byin rlabs can gyis rab gnas grub na legs// gal te rab gnas rgyas pa ma grub na// rin chen snod du ril bu blugs byas la// dar zab steng du rang gi mdun ngos bzhag

|skyabs sems sngon song rang nyid sman gyi bla// bai ḍūrya 'od phyag g.yas a ru ra// phyag g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i lhung bzed bsnams// mtshan dpes rab brgyan 'gro ba'i nad rnams sel| |tshe la bar du gcod pa zhi ba dang*// gnod pa'i bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang*// ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu la sogs pa// bsam pa'i bar du gcod pa zhi bar mdzod// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bhai ṣa dzye gu ru bai ḍūrya pra bha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samyaksaṃ buddhā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ bhai ṣa dzye bhai ṣa dzye/ ma hā bhai ṣa dzye/ bhai ṣa dzye rā dza sa muṅga te swā hā| zhes brjod rab gnas bsdus te bstan pa'o// dus dang rnam pa kun tu ril bu la// bud med nam mkha' nyi ma gsum po yis// ma mthong reg par mi bya dam tshig yin// bud med nad la gtong tshe skyes pas sbyin// sbyor ba 'di la ril nag chen mo zhes// chu srin gre ba'i nor bu nyin skar tsam// u duṃ bā ra yid bzhin nor bu bas// rab tu dkon phyir tsitta'i dbus su sba// de ltar tshad ldan ril bu'i phan yon ni// thog mar 'dre srung dang bya ra ba bzhag pa ni bshad pa'i rgyud las 'di skad gsungs// rgyal po'i pho brang srog 'tsho'i slob dpon bzhag /des ni zas skom dug las thar bar 'gyur// de phyir g.yer ma nyi dgas lcam 'bru rtsa kha dbye// ril bu bdun sogs 'bri mar khu bas dbul// zos rjes dom mkhris kha che gur gum gyis// rtsa kha bsdams la skyur sogs rgyun spangs pas// rkun bu byung tshe blon po sgres gces pa// ma gi ta gla rtsi yi dri mas bya gtong 'gyur// de tshe bsdu bsad sbyor ba dus gnad yin// gzhan yang dug rigs gyur tshad 'dis sel zhing*| |ma zhu glang 'thab smug po dreg grum dang*// rkang 'bam 'bras dang sūrya dmu chu skran// 'or dang skya rbab ya ma nag po sogs// gcong chen sde bzhi 'joms pa'i tho chen yin// mchin srin glang 'thab tsha ba rnying rnyog dang*// rims smyon rtsar rgyug tre tre ho la sogs// ril bu 'dis sleb de srog 'phral du ster// tsi tsi dzwa la'i nad gdon 'ur 'ded byed// mdor na bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad kun 'joms// sde brgyad sa bdag sgrib pa'i ri bo yin// rin chen tshe srog 'dzin pa'i lcags kyu ste// tshe ring rgas sra skra dkar nag por 'gro// 'chi ltas tshang dang gzhan dbang nad yin yang*| |'di yi dam rdzas myangs na mtho ris snyeg

/de min 'du ba'i nad kun ril bu 'dis// mi sel srid na sngon las rnam smin yin// de phyir nad kun sel ba'i sman gcig pu// sbyor ba 'di las mchis na e ma mtshar// de nas yid ches brgyud pa'i lo rgyus ni// mkha' 'gro'i dbang po dpal ldan phreng ba yis// grub chen o rgyan pa la gdams pa la// dngul 'bum zhes bya'i bstan bcos chen po mdzad// myur lam 'di ni snyigs dus sman gyi bla// dharma swa mi zhes bya gang de yis// kong sman dge slong puṇye maṅgar gnang*// des ni 'tsho mdzad dharma'i mtshan can la// de yis gso dpyad 'dzin pa dhwa dza la// de las 'ongs pa da dus snyigs ma 'dir// kho bo dharma kīrti'i tsittar gab// chig brgyud yin phyir gsang zhing sbos la shod// des na gdams pa'i mchog 'di thub pa'i phyir// zhang blon chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul dang*// rā hu la dang sman gyi lha mo dang*// drang srong brgyad kyis chos 'di thub par srungs// zol zog mkhan gyi bla srog hur thums bzhes// las 'phro ldan pa'i sdong grogs chos bzhin gyis// 'di dges 'gro kun sangs rgyas sman gyi bla// bai ḍūrya yi go 'phang thob par shog /ces pa 'di ni ril nag grang sbyor chen mo'i gdams pa zab mo chos kyi rje zur mkhar ba dharma swa mi'i gsung gi bdud rtsi ji lta bar nod pa'i sman pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi drin las byung ba/ shākya'i dge slong dharma kīrtis ba thang gi chos grwar sbyar ba'o// 'di'i mang nyung gi zho tshad rnams ril bu sbyor mang nyung la brten pa'i so so'i zho tshad rnams phri bsnan gang dgos da lta'i zho tshad 'dis rigs bsgres te bya'o// des ni 'khor gyi sman rnams zho tshad bshad pa ltar byas na dngul chu srang gang*/ gser srang gang*/ dngul do/ zangs gsum/ lcags bzhi/ lhang tsher srang gang*/ gzhan rin po che sogs 'khor sman thams cad gong gi mchan chung ltar byas pas legs par 'grub bo// dpe cha 'dir zho tshad rnams ni dpe lta bur bris pa yin pas dngul chu srang gang la sbyor na des 'di nang gi zho tshad kho nas chog la/
gzhan mang po'am nyung nyung gang sbyor yang zho tshad 'dis rigs bsgres nas sbyar dgos so/// /
